selected.title: Season’s Streamings and Savings: Black Friday Deals Come to GeForce NOW
selected.text: GeForce NOW is kicking off Black Friday with more reasons to make time for gaming. Six-month memberships are back for a limited time. Save 30% on the first six-month term of a Performance or Ultimate membership . Big gaming plans, smaller price tag. Keep the holiday savings going: Check out more NVIDIA holiday deals for gamers, creators and AI enthusiasts. The living room gets a little more playtime, too. GeForce NOW arrives on Amazon Fire TV Stick HD, Fire TV Stick 4K Select and Fire TV Stick 4K (2026 model) running Vega OS, alongside an Amazon offer launching later today for 90% off the first month of an eligible Performance or Ultimate membership in participating countries. It brings console-style gaming to the TV, straight from the Amazon cart. Bethesda fans have more in store, with five favorites adding GOG support as part of nine games joining GeForce NOW this week. Big RTX Power, Black Friday Price Thousands of games are calling from the cloud. Six-month Performance and Ultimate memberships are back for Black Friday, with 30% off the first six months for new memberships and eligible upgrades in select regions. The sale runs through Monday, Nov. 30, while supplies last. Go Ultimate for GeForce RTX 5080-class performance across PCs, Macs, Steam Deck and other supported handhelds, browsers, mobile devices, compatible TVs and more . Sessions lasting up to eight hours and first-priority server access leave more room for marathon play. Ultimate brings the latest NVIDIA innovations to the cloud, including DLSS 5 technology with the 3D-Guided Neural Rendering feature for lifelike lighting and materials in NBA 2K27 and Hogwarts Legacy , with support coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet . The experience goes big with streaming at up to 5K resolution or up to 360 frames per second, plus high dynamic range, ultrawide support and saved in-game settings. DLSS Super Resolution, Multi Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction enhance supported games, including the path-traced missions of 007 First Light and the reality-bending action of CONTROL Resonant , while NVIDIA Reflex and Cloud G-SYNC technologies help keep gameplay responsive and smooth. GeForce NOW handles downloads, patches and updates for Ready-to-Play games, freeing local storage and leaving more time for gaming. Choose a membership and start the season streaming. More Screens, Major Savings Press play on more possibilities. GeForce NOW officially expands to all three of Amazon’s Vega OS streaming media players including Fire TV Stick HD, Fire TV Stick 4K Select and Fire TV Stick 4K (2026 model) bringing thousands of supported games to more another screens in the home. Vega OS keeps Fire TV fast and responsive, so launching GeForce NOW and jumping into games feels quick and snappy, with no console required. Getting started is simple: download the GeForce NOW app on a supported Fire TV device , sign in and connect a compatible controller. From cozy stories to epic adventures, turn-based tactics to co-op challenges, there’s plenty to build, explore and share with friends — all from the comfort of the couch. There’s a fire deal to get the games going, too. Launching later today through Thursday, Dec. 31, get 90% off the first month of a Performance or Ultimate membership purchased directly through Amazon on supported Fire TV devices in participating regions. The cloud is ready. The next quest is calling. GOG Big or Go Home Five favorite worlds. Extra ways to play. Five Bethesda titles expand their GeForce NOW support this week with their GOG versions: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle , Fallout 4 , The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , DOOM and DOOM Eternal . Uncover an ancient mystery in Indiana Jones and the Great Circle , a first-person adventure set between Raiders of the Lost Ark and The Last Crusade . Explore the wasteland in Fallout 4 or trade the Pip-Boy for dragons and open-world fantasy in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim . For a faster change of pace, DOOM brings relentless enemies, destructive weapons and fast-moving first-person combat, while its sequel, DOOM Eternal , turns up the intensity as the Slayer takes on demonic forces. Members who own the newly supported GOG versions can stream those titles through GeForce NOW without purchasing them again. From treasure hunts to dragon hunts, the collection can follow across nearly any supported device. Familiar worlds, with a little more room to roam. Members can look for the following games joining the GeForce NOW library this week: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed (New release on Steam , Nov. 19) Baldur’s Gate 3 ( Xbox Play Anywhere) DOOM (2016) ( GOG ) DOOM Eternal ( GOG ) Fallout 4 ( GOG ) Graveyard Keeper 2 ( Epic Games Store and GOG ) Indiana Jones and the Great Circle ( GOG ) Moon Sweepers ( Steam ) The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition ( GOG ) Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after release and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates on announced titles. Make it a cloud gaming weekend. Grab a day pass to try Performance or Ultimate before committing to a monthly membership, with the day pass cost applicable toward that first month. What’s on the big-screen gaming lineup this weekend? Let us know on X or in the comments below.
